Editorial says Stevenson burdened by mistakes of New Deal and Fair Deal; less likely to admit/correct than fresh administration
Leadership editorial: 'only the Democratic candidate, John Connally, can offer the necessary leadership and direction to Texas state government'; qualifications much superior

Editorial 'Connally Has Exceptional Qualities for Governorship': If elected, John Connally will enter the governor's office as perhaps the best informed chief executive Texas has ever had; No candidate for governor has ever gone to greater lengths to prepare himself for that office

Reported in AP article 'Candidates Endorsed By Papers' (published in Tyler Morning Telegraph): Atty. Gen. Waggoner Carr, Democrat, has the endorsement of 28 dailies and 18 weeklies, including Corpus Christi Caller and Times

Editorial 'Hard Worker': Rep. Frances Farenthold brought freshness and enthusiasm to the chore of lawmaking during the 61st Legislature; she feels strongly about honesty in government, the rights of minorities, pollution, and equal educational opportunity; almost single-handedly persuaded the Legislature to censure Land Commissioner Jerry Sadler; took a leading part in the passage of the Antiquities Act; she deserves to be reelected Nov. 3 because she has worked hard for Corpus Christi and Texas and will continue to do so
